$comment: CANONICAL SKILL DEFINITIONS. This file is the single source of truth for the
governed skill catalog. The Go registry (gateway/skills_gen.go) and the
TypeScript contract (contracts/src/skills.gen.ts) are GENERATED from it by
contracts/gen/generate.mjs — do not edit those by hand.
Adding a skill is one edit here plus a behavior implementation in
gateway/skills.go (read_only/local_effect fixture or effect body). Run
`make generate`; `make test` fails if the generated files drift.
The manifest is language-neutral on purpose: Go owns enforcement, TypeScript
owns the UI contract, and Rust may own node-side effects later. None of them
